GRADE 5 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About My purpose Talents and abilities at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully,
   B. Learners should ignore My purpose Talents and abilities completely.
   C. My purpose Talents and abilities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My purpose Talents and abilities.

2. About My purpose Talents and abilities at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the parable of the talents,
   B. Learners should ignore My purpose Talents and abilities completely.
   C. My purpose Talents and abilities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My purpose Talents and abilities.

3. About My purpose Talents and abilities when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore My purpose Talents and abilities completely.
   C. My purpose Talents and abilities is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My purpose Talents and abilities.

5. About Work at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify three responsibilities given to human beings by God,
   B. Learners should ignore Work completely.
   C. Work is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work.

6. About Work at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate good stewardship by taking care of God’s creation,
   B. Learners should ignore Work completely.
   C. Work is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work.

7. About Work when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline their roles at home, school and church,
   B. Learners should ignore Work completely.
   C. Work is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work.

9. About The Fall of Man at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11,
   B. Learners should ignore The Fall of Man completely.
   C. The Fall of Man is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Fall of Man.

10. About The Fall of Man at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. outline five lessons learnt from the fall of man,
   B. Learners should ignore The Fall of Man completely.
   C. The Fall of Man is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Fall of Man.

11. About The Fall of Man when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11,
   B. Learners should ignore The Fall of Man completely.
   C. The Fall of Man is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Fall of Man.

13. About Family Unity at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the importance of family unity,
   B. Learners should ignore Family Unity completely.
   C. Family Unity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Family Unity.

14. About Family Unity at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify challenges faced by families today,
   B. Learners should ignore Family Unity completely.
   C. Family Unity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Family Unity.

15. About Family Unity when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline ways he/she can contribute to a happy family,
   B. Learners should ignore Family Unity completely.
   C. Family Unity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Family Unity.

17. About The Bible as a Guide at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline different uses of the Bible in society today,
   B. Learners should ignore The Bible as a Guide completely.
   C. The Bible as a Guide is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Bible as a Guide.

18. About The Bible as a Guide at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the benefits of reading the Bible,
   B. Learners should ignore The Bible as a Guide completely.
   C. The Bible as a Guide is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Bible as a Guide.

19. About The Bible as a Guide when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline different uses of the Bible in society today,
   B. Learners should ignore The Bible as a Guide completely.
   C. The Bible as a Guide is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Bible as a Guide.

21. About Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the story of Peter and John in the Temple,
   B. Learners should ignore Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple completely.
   C. Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

22. About Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. outline lessons learnt from the story of Peter and John,
   B. Learners should ignore Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple completely.
   C. Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

23. About Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss why Christians should stand firm in their faith
   B. Learners should ignore Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple completely.
   C. Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

25. About King Solomon the wise ruler at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the story of King Solomon,
   B. Learners should ignore King Solomon the wise ruler completely.
   C. King Solomon the wise ruler is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise King Solomon the wise ruler.

26. About King Solomon the wise ruler at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. outline lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon,
   B. Learners should ignore King Solomon the wise ruler completely.
   C. King Solomon the wise ruler is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise King Solomon the wise ruler.

27. About King Solomon the wise ruler when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life
   B. Learners should ignore King Solomon the wise ruler completely.
   C. King Solomon the wise ruler is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise King Solomon the wise ruler.

29. About Noah and his sons at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the story of Noah and his sons,
   B. Learners should ignore Noah and his sons completely.
   C. Noah and his sons is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Noah and his sons.

30. About Noah and his sons at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain five ways of showing respect to the elderly,
   B. Learners should ignore Noah and his sons completely.
   C. Noah and his sons is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Noah and his sons.

31. About Noah and his sons when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the story of Noah and his sons,
   B. Learners should ignore Noah and his sons completely.
   C. Noah and his sons is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Noah and his sons.

SECTION B: Short Answers

8. Give two examples of how you can use Work at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Family Unity at home with your family.
